title: Switch to TikTok Before Making
tests: Tests whether a mid-plan platform change overrides the original aspect ratio while retaining the creative brief.

faults.what: The clip contains audible speech, transcribed as "Always enforced to what mind pays", despite the explicit request for no sound.

judge.summary: The vertical animation delivers the cosy illustrated coffee scene with curling steam and rain, but unwanted speech violates the silence requirement.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is vertical 9:16, not widescreen.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames have a vertical 9:16 composition.

must_haves.item: A coffee cup sits on a windowsill with visible rain outside.
must_haves.why: A coffee-filled cup rests on the wooden windowsill in front of a rain-streaked window.

must_haves.item: Steam visibly curls upward from the cup.
must_haves.why: A curling steam plume rises from the coffee and changes shape across the sampled frames.

must_haves.item: The scene has a cosy illustrated appearance.
must_haves.why: Warm wood tones, a potted plant, and softly shaded illustration create a cosy scene.

must_haves.item: The video lasts approximately 6 seconds and contains no text or audio.
must_haves.why: The reported 6.6-second duration is approximately six seconds, and no text is visible, but the sound report confirms audio containing speech.
